key_insight: OracleImitator learns which feature to acquire next by distilling an oracle teacher that ranks candidates by their effect on prediction error.
engineering_relevance: Instance-specific feature acquisition can reduce measurement costs, delays, or privacy exposure while preserving predictive accuracy.
method: Construct a training-time oracle using labels and unobserved feature values.
Distill the oracle’s candidate rankings into a deployable policy through soft-target imitation.
Measure how much oracle ranking information is recoverable from deployment-visible inputs.
evidence_signal: Across multimodal medical diagnosis and AFABench, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across budgets, recovering 90% of attainable accuracy gain at under one-quarter of acquisition cost.
watch_item: The teacher requires labels and unobserved feature values during training, while the deployed policy must approximate its rankings without that privileged information.
paper_title: Active Feature Acquisition by Distilling an Oracle Teacher
